articles.title: Philadelphia Science Museum Closes as Supporters Seek a Way to Reopen
articles.summary: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences museum closed on September 30. A foundation offered one year of funding, but reopening remains uncertain.

articles.title: Judge Pauses Border Wall Work in Texas' Big Bend Region
articles.summary: A federal judge temporarily paused border wall work across Texas' Big Bend border sector, including its national park, while the court considers a legal challenge.

articles.title: Nearly 1,400 Workers Laid Off at Ohio Truck Factory
articles.summary: Nearly 1,400 workers lost jobs at a Springfield, Ohio, truck factory. Worker Kyle Bos says the layoffs helped change his political plans before November's election.
